item.title: Web Components in 2026: Lit vs FAST vs Stencil — Which Should You Actually Build On?
item.description: Every frontend team has a rewrite scar. The framework that felt inevitable five years ago is now a maintenance item, and the component library built on top of it is welded to a version that is no longer supported. Web Components are the one part of the browser platform that outlives the framework cycle: <status-badge> is a custom element today, in five years, and after the next three framework migrations.
